name: Playment
long_description:
"Computers are incredibly fast, accurate and stupid; humans are incredibly slow, inaccurate and brilliant; together they are powerful beyond imagination."​

Playment is a fully managed data labeling platform generating training data for computer vision models at scale. We empower companies in the Autonomous Vehicle, Drones, Mapping, and similar spaces with high precision annotation services - No matter how complex. We’re helping companies and research institutions like Drive AI, Starsky Robotics, CYNGN, and UIUC focus on their core areas of development.

Our platform is powered by a trained workforce of 300,000+ users and managed by our human intelligence experts who build your tasks and deliver results with assured quality.

Support Annotation types: Bounding Boxes, Cuboids, Polygons, and Polylines, Point annotations, Segmentation(coming soon) for both image and video data types. Interested to hear more? please check out https://playment.io

Use Cases we worked on: Autonomous vehicles, drones, satellite imagery, precision agriculture, Retail / eCommerce, sports analytics

launches.title: Design Arena - #1 Benchmark for AI Design
launches.tagline: Attracted 47K+ users across 136 countries in 4 weeks
launches.body:
**📣 TLDR**

[**Design Arena**](https://www.designarena.ai/) **is the first crowdsourced benchmark for AI-generated design.**

We evaluate how models perform on real-world design tasks - frontend, audio, image, video and more - with live, organic users. It’s the first step of our broader **mission at [Arcada Labs](http://Arcada.dev) to** **distill and understand the human experience.**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92609&key=user_uploads/876530/8919d5ba-9d0e-47e0-9cb9-83ed83b21630)

**❌ Problem**

LLMs can pass bar exams and win IMO gold, but they still generate UIs with white text on a white background. 

There’s no standard to measure taste, usability, or aesthetics, and no benchmark means no pressure to improve.

**🏆 Solution**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ay89pA_wUHM

We’re building the definitive benchmark for AI-generated design.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=92609&key=user_uploads/876530/134587f7-3fb8-4a2f-9a8b-d001c05d68da)

**🫶 Ask**

Know someone you want to see on the leaderboard? Send us a message at [**founders@designarena.ai**](mailto:founders@designarena.ai)!

**💛 Team**

We’re all best friends from Harvard! 

**Kamryn Ohly** (CTO): Harvard Computer Science & Education, prev. Apple

**Grace Li** (CEO): Harvard Computer Science & Neuroscience, prev. Apple

launches.title: Hub: real-world training data for frontier AI labs and robotics
launches.tagline: Leveraging a global human network to collect data that don’t exist yet.
launches.body:
Hub provides real-world training data to frontier AI labs and robotics companies. We went to 7-figure revenue agreement on data delivery during the last weeks, working with some of the biggest names in AI and robotics.\
\
**Why now**

The gap between frontier models is closing, and internet-scale data is largely exhausted. The only edge left is real-world data that humans have to produce. Every lab now wins or loses on its edge cases, and edge cases need specific data captured by specific people: data that doesn't exist anywhere online. Whoever can go collect the right data first ships the better model first. Human labor is half of global GDP, and almost none of it has been recorded yet.

**What Hub does**

We capture this data through a global network of humans, across all continents. We route and activate the exact people who fit a lab's brief and deliver in days, not the months it takes to source a generic dataset off the shelf. Because we collect the data ourselves, we can attest its provenance, which you can't do for data you didn't capture. Our ML and QA pipelines then verify and enrich it, so we meet the hardest dataset requirements labs throw at us. The moat isn't the data, it's how fast we can go get it.

**Traction**

From 5-figure to 7-figure in revenue agreement on successful data delivery. We now work with some of the biggest frontier AI labs and robotics companies in the world.

**The ask**

Two asks: —> You're building frontier models or robots and data is your constraint. \
—> You're a top robotics engineer, a PhD whose research touches robotics or egocentric data, or someone with deep experience at a leading robotics lab, we're hiring. \
\
Reach out here: [founders@hub.xyz](mailto:founders@hub.xyz).
